Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-canoe-seakayak/

Explore the natural beauty of Lake Naguri paddling wooden sea kayaks handcrafted from local timber. This guided eco-tour includes a homemade pizza lunch.

【Fee】
Adults: ¥6,000 / Elementary school and under: ¥4,000
(Includes guide, insurance, kayak rental, and food)

【Capacity】
2 two-person kayaks

【Guide】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop staff

【What to bring】
Drink, towel, change of clothes (you may get wet), clothes suitable for getting wet. Bring sun protection (hat, sunglasses, etc.) as needed.

【More information】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
